table note: Click a column header to sort. The order is a display choice only — it does not mean a ranking.
total cost note: Total cost = price + environmental impacts converted to yen (derived from the rates you set on the My plan page).
pesticide residue: present (health impac: pesticide residue: present (health impact not assessed)
compare page description: A line connects two foods when the upper one is at least as good on every selected axis (more is better for nutrients; less is better for costs: price, CO2e, land, water) — a strict upgrade. Pairs with no line (e.g. organic vs conventional) are trade-offs; neither is simply better.
compare methodology note: Environmental impact figures are world averages by food category from Poore & Nemecek (2018); differences by origin are not corrected. Nutrients and costs (price, CO2e, land, water) are compared as independent axes, keeping incomparable pairs. Conversion to yen is used only by the meal-plan optimizer and the table's total-cost column. Health effects of pesticide residues are not quantified and are treated as "not assessed".

domination axes note: Axes: nutrient density per 100 g (protein, fiber) and costs (price, CO2e). An upgrade = at least as good on every axis and strictly better on at least one.
See in the full Hasse diagram: See in the full comparison graph
hasse orientation note: A line means the upper food is a strict upgrade over the lower one (at least as good on every selected axis, strictly better on at least one). Pairs with no line are trade-offs — vertical position alone doesn't rank them. Hover a card to highlight only the foods strictly above it (upgrades) and strictly below it. Click a food card to open its detail page.
hasse orientation note (single axis): With a single axis, all foods line up in one ranked column — higher is better (ties sit side by side). Click a food card to open its detail page.
environmental pricing intro: Environmental impacts (CO2e, land, water) are converted to yen, added to food costs, and the plan is re-optimized for the lowest total cost. Leave the rates at 0 to optimize on price alone. There is no single correct rate — use the references as a guide and set them to match your own priorities. The rates are also used by the total-cost column on the compare page.
failed to recalculate: Failed to recalculate. Check your connection and try again.
co2e price reference: Reference: J-Credit market price ≈ 1–4 JPY/kg; social cost of carbon estimates ≈ 20–30 JPY/kg
land price reference: Reference: average annual farmland rent in Japan ≈ 5–15 JPY/m²
water price reference: Reference: household tap water ≈ 0.1–0.4 JPY/L (agricultural water is cheaper)
isolated foods heading: Foods not connected to any other food (every pairing is a trade-off)
